operationSets.name: InvoiceActions
operationSets.comment:
An invoice's backfill for any signed-in caller (D103's step 4):
assignNumber at invoice/{id}/number/assign-number numbers an invoice made
before the table numbered, and answers the number of one numbered
already.

operations.name: numberAssignNumber
operations.comment: Numbers an instance created before its schema composed Numbering, in the count of the year it was created in, as its create would have. On an instance numbered already it changes nothing and returns its number. A deployment backfills by invoking it in creation order.
